# Attendance Record

## Summary
Learner × live lesson × day × mark. Upserted by Mark Attendance; counted by the completion rule.

## Usage
Rendered in bulk by Attendance Grid.

## Non-goals
No check-in mechanics.

## Example
The linked record is one learner's mark for the module 1 kickoff session. Present, late and excused all count as attended; only absent counts against the learner.
attributes.cardDescription: One learner's mark for one live lesson on one day, upserted by Mark Attendance and counted by the completion rule.
